messages.subject: Rook - Redirect - what happens to the new line characters?
messages.subject_clean: Rook - Redirect - what happens to the new line characters?
messages.body_plain:
I've been using Rook recently with the idea of using it as a simple reporting front end. The user chooses 2 dates and a ticker, clicks submit, then a googleVis chart is rendered. I'm almost there, except for one annoying issue. Redirect in Rook appears to remove all new line chars, which means that the comments in the googleVis javascript cause the chart to break. For example: // jsFunction function x becomes // jsFunction function x Any idea what I could do to get it working? I have tested it with the brew example files (apple stock) and get the same problem via Rook redirects. Any help would be much appreciated. This is my setup: startWebServer.R ============== require("Rook") s<-Rhttpd$new() s$start(listen='0.0.0.0', port=8080, quiet=TRUE) s$add(name="Test App", app=Builder$new( Brewery$new(url="/",root="C:/FundamentalDB/brew/"), Redirect$new("/test.html"))) test.html ================
From date:
To date:
Ticker:
<% brew('exampleResults.rhtml') %> exampleResults.rhtml =================== <% require(googleVis) if (is.null(req$GET)) return() GET <- req$GET() ticker<-GET$ticker fromDate<-as.Date(GET$fromDate, "%Y-%m-%d") toDate<-as.Date(GET$toDate, "%Y-%m-%d") URL <- paste("http://ichart.finance.yahoo.com/table.csv?s=", ticker, sep="") dat <- read.csv(URL, colClasses=c("Date", rep("numeric",6))) dat$Date <- as.Date(dat$Date, "%Y-%m-%d") dat<-dat[dat$Date >= fromDate & dat$Date <= toDate, ] dat[order(dat$Date),]<-dat g<-gvisAnnotatedTimeLine(dat, datevar="Date", numvar="Close") cat(g$html$chart, file="tempChart.htm") %> <%= g$html$chart %>
